directory.name: Thar Institute of Engineering, Sciences & Technology (TIEST - NED University)
directory.description: A constituent campus of NED University of Engineering and Technology, Karachi. Established to provide world-class engineering, computer science, and technical education to the youth of Tharparkar and Sindh.
directory.sourceReference: NED University Official Portal & Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan

directory.name: Government Boys Degree College Mithi
directory.address: College Road, Near District Complex, Mithi
directory.description: The premier public higher secondary and undergraduate college in Mithi, affiliated with the University of Sindh, offering Intermediate and Bachelor programs in Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical, Science, and Arts.
directory.sourceReference: College Education Department, Government of Sindh

directory.name: Government Girls Degree College Mithi
directory.description: Dedicated public degree institution empowering female education across Tharparkar. Offers accredited intermediate and graduate study tracks with dedicated transportation and mentoring.
directory.sourceReference: College Education Department, Government of Sindh

directory.name: Thar Institute of Nursing & Allied Health Sciences Mithi
directory.description: Recognized medical and nursing training institute affiliated with the Sindh Nurses Examination Board and Pakistan Nursing Council, affiliated with DHQ Civil Hospital Mithi for clinical rotations.
directory.sourceReference: Sindh Health Department & Pakistan Nursing Council

directory.name: Government Boys Degree College Islamkot
directory.description: Key higher secondary college serving Islamkot taluka and adjacent mining communities, fostering youth progression into regional engineering and medical universities.

directory.name: Government Degree College Nagarparkar
directory.description: Crucial educational pillar providing higher education to the border youth of Nagarparkar, offering intermediate and associate degree programs.

directory.name: Government Degree College Diplo
directory.description: Renowned educational landmark in Diplo, historically recognized for producing scholars, civil servants, and educators from Tharparkar.

directory.name: Government Degree College Chachro
directory.description: Serving students from northern Tharparkar, providing rigorous coaching in science and arts with extensive regional student enrollment.

directory.name: Government Technical & Vocational Training Center (STEVTA) Mithi
directory.description: Sindh Technical Education & Vocational Training Authority center equipping local youth with technical skills in solar PV installation, electrical wiring, heavy machinery mechanics, and welding.

directory.name: The Citizens Foundation (TCF) School Campus Mithi
directory.description: Purpose-built non-profit English-medium school providing high quality modern primary and secondary education with an all-female faculty and subsidized tuition.

directory.name: Thar Foundation Model School (SECMC Campus)
directory.address: Block II Thar Coal Road, Islamkot
directory.description: Modern educational facility built under corporate social responsibility by Thar Foundation and SECMC, providing smart classrooms and STEM curricula.

directory.name: Government Boys High School Mithi (Est. 1904)
directory.description: One of the oldest educational institutions in Tharparkar, founded in 1904. Has nurtured generations of notable Sindhi intellectuals, writers, and leaders.

directory.name: Government Girls High School Mithi
directory.description: Leading public girls school in the district center, with dedicated science laboratories and arts programs.

directory.name: Civil Hospital Mithi (District Headquarters Hospital - DHQ)
directory.description: The primary tertiary healthcare institution in District Tharparkar, equipped with a 24/7 emergency department, specialized Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU), Nutrition Stabilization Center (NSC), gynecology ward, blood bank, and surgical theaters.
directory.sourceReference: Sindh Health Department, Directorate General Health Services

directory.name: Thar Foundation Hospital (Indus Hospital Network Partner)
directory.description: State-of-the-art charitable hospital operated in partnership with The Indus Hospital & Health Network. Delivers completely free, paperless healthcare to desert residents including surgical and pediatric care.
directory.sourceReference: Indus Hospital & Health Network Verified Registry

directory.name: Taluka Headquarters (THQ) Hospital Nagarparkar
directory.description: Public taluka hospital serving Nagarparkar and surrounding rural settlements across the Karoonjhar region with emergency stabilization, snake-bite treatment center, and maternity services.

directory.name: Taluka Headquarters (THQ) Hospital Islamkot
directory.description: Government taluka hospital providing primary and secondary medical care, mother & child health services, and 24-hour casualty unit.

directory.name: Taluka Headquarters (THQ) Hospital Diplo
directory.description: Government healthcare center for Diplo taluka providing pediatric care, gynecological consultations, basic surgery, and diagnostic lab tests.

directory.name: Taluka Headquarters (THQ) Hospital Chachro
directory.description: Major public healthcare anchor for the northern desert taluka, providing emergency response, anti-venom treatments, and maternal delivery wards.

directory.name: Rural Health Center (RHC) Chelhar
directory.description: Primary rural healthcare facility offering 24-hour emergency triage, labor and delivery, and outpatient treatments.

directory.name: Basic Health Unit (BHU) Bhalwa
directory.description: First-level public health facility serving local desert villages with maternal consultations, nutritional support, and vaccinations.

directory.name: STDC Rooplo Kolhi Resort Nagarparkar
directory.address: At the foot of Karoonjhar Mountains, Nagarparkar
directory.description: Official tourism resort operated by the Sindh Tourism Development Corporation (STDC). Set against the dramatic pink granite backdrop of the Karoonjhar Mountains, offering air-conditioned rooms, suites, traditional dining, and guided mountain trek bookings.
directory.sourceReference: Sindh Tourism Development Corporation (STDC) Official Portal

directory.name: STDC Sambara Motel & Tourist Center Mithi
directory.address: Bypass Road, Near Circuit House, Mithi
directory.description: Comfortable public motel managed by STDC providing well-furnished family accommodation, clean dining, and tourist information for visitors exploring Mithi and the desert.

directory.name: Government Circuit House Mithi
directory.description: Official district guest house maintained by the Services, General Administration & Coordination Department (SGA&CD) for visiting government dignitaries, researchers, and official delegations.

directory.name: Gadhi Bhit Desert Safari Huts & Camp
directory.address: Gadhi Bhit Sand Dune Ridge, Mithi
directory.description: Authentic traditional straw-thatched "Chaunra" desert huts and eco-friendly guest accommodations located next to Gadhi Bhit dune, providing sunset camel rides and stargazing.

directory.name: Marvi Cultural Complex Rest House
directory.description: Culture & Antiquities Department guest facility situated adjacent to the historic Marvi Well, offering serene lodging for heritage researchers and cultural tourists.
directory.sourceReference: Culture, Tourism, Antiquities & Archives Department Sindh

directory.name: Deputy Commissioner (DC) Office Tharparkar
directory.address: District Administrative Complex, Naukot Road, Mithi
directory.description: The supreme administrative authority of District Tharparkar, overseeing revenue administration, law & order coordination, relief operations, water schemes, and development programs.

directory.name: Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP) Office Tharparkar
directory.description: Headquarters of Sindh Police for District Tharparkar. Coordinates police stations across all talukas, traffic control, security protocols, and 24/7 emergency dispatch helpline.

directory.name: NADRA Registration Center (NRC) Mithi
directory.description: National Database and Registration Authority facility for the issuance of Computerized National Identity Cards (CNIC), Child Registration Certificates (B-Form), Family Registration, and Biometric verifications.

directory.name: Municipal Committee Mithi
directory.description: Urban municipal authority in charge of public cleanliness, street lighting, municipal water supplies, and business trade licenses in Mithi city.

directory.name: District Education Office (DEO) Tharparkar
directory.description: Supervisory authority directing primary, elementary, and secondary education, teacher appointments, school monitoring, and textbook supplies across 3,000+ district schools.

directory.name: Habib Bank Limited (HBL) Mithi Branch & 24/7 ATM
directory.description: Leading commercial bank branch providing retail banking, commercial loans, livestock financing, international remittances, and 24/7 biometric cash withdrawal ATM.
directory.sourceReference: State Bank of Pakistan Branch Registry
directory.hours: Monday to Friday: 09:00 AM - 05:00 PM (ATM 24 Hours)

directory.name: National Bank of Pakistan (NBP) Islamkot
directory.description: Commercial bank branch supporting treasury operations, civil servant pensions, public payments, and general customer accounts with round-the-clock ATM.
directory.sourceReference: National Bank of Pakistan Official Directory

directory.name: Tharparkar Women Artisans Ralli & Handicrafts Cooperative
directory.description: Grassroots artisan collective representing over 400 skilled rural women embroiderers and weavers from villages across Mithi, Diplo, and Islamkot. Sells authentic hand-stitched Ralli quilts, mirror-work kurtas, cushions, and camel-leather goods directly at fair-trade prices.
directory.sourceReference: Sindh Small Industries Corporation & Artisan Registry

directory.name: Thar Heritage Desert Tours & Expeditions
directory.description: Certified local travel and safari company offering licensed 4x4 desert dune safaris, camel caravans, cultural village excursions, Karoonjhar hiking tours, and eco-camping under Thar’s star-filled skies.

directory.name: Gadhi Bhit Sand Dune & Viewpoint
directory.description: The highest and most famous sand dune viewpoint in Mithi. Crowned with an iconic pink-red brick monument and the vibrant "I Love Mithi" installation. It offers a 360-degree panoramic vista of Mithi city and the golden rolling desert dunes, where sunset skies transform into brilliant oranges, purples, and golds as peacocks gather.
directory.sourceReference: Sindh Tourism Development Corporation (STDC) & District Heritage Registry

directory.name: Karoonjhar Mountains & Pink Granite Hills
directory.description: A breathtaking 16-mile-long ancient granite mountain range rising dramatically out of the flat desert sands. Famous for its pink and grey granite formations, natural medicinal flora, seasonal freshwater streams (Sardharo and Anchlesar), and rich historical sanctuaries. Local Thari lore proclaims: "Karoonjhar produces a hundred kilograms of gold each day" in celebration of its natural wealth.
directory.sourceReference: Culture, Tourism & Antiquities Department Sindh & Geological Survey of Pakistan

directory.name: Historic Naukot Fort (Gateway to Thar Desert)
directory.description: An imposing historical fort erected in 1814 by Mir Karam Ali Khan Talpur to safeguard the trade route into the desert. Constructed with millions of fired clay bricks, massive rounded ramparts, arched gateways, dungeon chambers, and battlements commanding panoramic views of the desert horizon.
directory.sourceReference: Sindh Antiquities Department Protected Heritage Monument No. 41

directory.name: Gori Temple (Historic 14th-Century Jain Shrine)
directory.description: An architectural marvel of medieval Jain design constructed in 1375 AD with Gujarati-style marble and sandstone. Features 52 intricate carved sub-shrines (devalikas) and exquisite ceiling frescoes depicting the life of Lord Parshvanatha, marking it as one of South Asia’s most unique medieval heritage monuments.
directory.sourceReference: Directorate of Antiquities Sindh & UNESCO Tentative List Documentation

directory.name: Bhodesar Mosque & Water Reservoir
directory.description: Built in 1505 AD by Sultan Mahmud Begada of Gujarat, this historic white marble and sandstone mosque rests on a square plinth at the edge of the scenic Bhodesar water reservoir. Its elegant arches and corbelled dome reflect the synthesis of Gujarati and Islamic architectural styles.

directory.name: Marvi’s Well (Umar Marvi Cultural Complex)
directory.description: The legendary well celebrated in the romantic folk epic of Umar Marvi and immortalized in Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai’s "Sur Marui". Marvi chose desert loyalty and patriotism over royal luxury. The site houses a landscaped cultural park, folk museum, amphitheater, and the historical stone well.
programsOrServices: Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai Cultural Exhibits

directory.name: Sant Nenuram Ashram & Open Community Kitchen
directory.description: Renowned spiritual retreat founded by 20th-century saint Sant Nenuram. It stands as an enduring beacon of interfaith harmony, serving complimentary hot meals (Langar) every day to thousands of travelers, pilgrims, and locals regardless of religion, caste, or background.
directory.sourceReference: Sant Nenuram Trust & District Information Office
